title: Microsoft Edge: Commercial Journeys (Get things done) task cards on the Copilot new tab page
summary: The briefing passes: its prerequisites, default, retention period and administrative controls are supported by Microsoft documentation, and its roadmap facts match the record. Its claim that users see the Copilot new tab page most often is unsupported and should be narrowed to identify the surface without ranking its usage.
